column1: # Sweeps --slope in {300,400,500,600,700} riding the current compiled defaults
# (floor=80, clsselectp=15, min_weight=10, oldestsource=1). slope is the
# transfer gradient in /1000 units, so these are 0.3..0.7 bracketing the
# compiled default of 500 (0.5). Each transfer is slope/1000*(src_w-80):
# steeper slope = larger per-transfer donations (the floor is unchanged at 80,
# only the steepness varies). sl500 is the current default (baseline anchor).
